name: Image Color Picker
description: Pick colors from an image and extract its main color palette
help: Open or drop an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, ICO). Click anywhere on it to pick that color; use the arrow keys to move one pixel at a time (hold Shift for 10).
Choose 1 px, or average a 3×3, 5×5 or 9×9 area to smooth out noise in photos. The magnifier shows the pixels around the point.
Each color is shown as HEX, RGB, HSL and OKLCH, with its contrast against white and black text.

The palette groups the image's colors in the perceptual OKLab space and lists the main ones by share; transparent pixels are ignored. Export copies it as CSS variables, SCSS, a Tailwind config, JSON, a GIMP palette or plain HEX.
